svg.text: Derived from the backend (models, controllers) and the frontend (forms, pages). The database physically stores 3 collections; each box says where its data lives.
jobs.type - list is in the frontend
jobs.mode - list is in the frontend
key that is also a reference
This is a LOGICAL model: it splits what the code
stores in 3 collections into the concepts the backend
- UpdateProfile: one allowed-field list per role
- photo / resume url + publicId -> 2 file entities.
as tags and lists in the UI -> 3 small entities.
- statusHistory[] shown as a timeline in the UI.
- Enumerations: status, role and OTP purpose are in
the schemas; job types and work modes are fixed
lists in PostJobModal only (the DB stores free text).
Physical reality: only users, jobs and applications
are collections. Foreign keys are Mongoose references
resolved in code, not enforced by MongoDB. Unique
applicant). No notification, bookmark or message
entity exists in the code, so none is drawn.
